name: BenchVul
description:
Dataset Card for BenchVul
	

BenchVul is a manually verified benchmark dataset designed for evaluating vulnerability detection models on the Top 25 Most Dangerous CWE weaknesses. It is intended for reliable and independent assessment of model generalization.

	
		
		Dataset Details
	

BenchVul addresses evaluation bias in vulnerability detection by providing a balanced and carefully curated benchmark. Each CWE category includes an equal number of vulnerable and fixed samples.
